$comment: Stackra file contract — Purpose: the public site's own strings in en (namespace `web::`); Boundary: same keys in every locale (gen fails otherwise); the derived keys of the site's classes live under `errors.<code>.message`, `enums.<enum>.<code>` and `flags.<flag>.label`, so page strings for error screens are `error_page.*`; every Arabic plural carries zero, one, two, few, many and other; another namespace's strings are overridden in assets/overrides/<namespace>/<locale>.json; Runtime: isomorphic; Governing contract: ADR 0234 d9, ADR 0294 (decision 20: derived keys), ADR 0192 (ICU plurals)
